params.prompt:
Edit the attached image. It is a square 1:1 Facebook ad for a book. Reproduce it EXACTLY: the same background photo (sunset sky, clouds, the translucent silhouette of a woman with her arm raised on the right), the same colours, the same layout, the same typefaces, the same text sizes and positions. Make only the two changes below.

CHANGE 1: Replace the Romanian text with the English text given here. Each English text sits in the same place, in the same typeface, weight, colour and size as the text it replaces. Spell every word exactly as written, nothing added, nothing left out.

- Headline, top left, black, set in League Spartan Bold: the same compact geometric sans-serif as the original headline, with the same letter proportions, the same stroke weight and the same tight letter-spacing. Do not use a wider typeface and do not widen the letter-spacing. All caps, two lines, no full stop at the end. Same cap height as the original headline. The headline letters are small and compact: the capital letters are only about 4.4% of the image height tall, exactly like the original headline, in the same narrow League Spartan letterforms (not Montserrat, not a wide face). Line 1 starts at the original left margin and is about 34% of the image width wide; line 2 is about 41% of the image width wide. The body paragraph starts clearly below the headline, as in the original.
  line 1: REAL CHANGE
  line 2: BEGINS WITHIN
  All black.

- Body paragraph under the headline (Montserrat Bold, black, sentence case, inside quotation marks), same left margin as the headline, in exactly the same typeface, weight and size as the original text it replaces, left-aligned, exactly five lines broken like this:
  line 1: “Real success and deep contentment
  line 2: can only be reached once the harmful
  line 3: stress patterns stored in our
  line 4: subconscious are cleared. After that,
  line 5: your life can change without effort.”
  All black.

- Red serrated seal, bottom right, same size, shape and position as the original. Condensed all-caps type on exactly three lines, each line centred horizontally, and the three-line block centred vertically in the seal. Line 1 (GET IT) is pale gold. Lines 2 and 3 are entirely white: all three words of TODAY AT THE are white, and BEST PRICE! is white:
  line 1: GET IT
  line 2: TODAY AT THE
  line 3: BEST PRICE!

CHANGE 2: Remove these things completely: the two red books, the round red-and-gold plus sign, and the dark red label "OFERTĂ NOUĂ!" next to it. Fill the area where they were with the natural continuation of the background (the warm glowing sunset sky above, the dark golden field at the bottom edge). Leave that whole area empty: no books, no objects, no shadows, no text.

Every apostrophe in the image is the same curved typographic apostrophe (’). Quotation marks are curved (“ and ”).

Do not add anything else: no new elements, no logos, no watermark, no border. No Romanian words may remain anywhere in the image.
